name: @vectalon-dev/core
description: Vectalon core — auth, licensing, billing, telemetry, and platform interfaces
author: Vectalon

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs');if(fs.existsSync('src/index.ts')){require('child_process').execSync('npm run build',{cwd:'src',stdio:'inherit',shell:true});fs.rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true});fs.cpSync('src/dist','dist',{recursive:true})}else{console.log('src/ missing — skipping core build (dist is pre-built)')}"
scripts.test: node -e "if(require('fs').existsSync('src')){require('child_process').execSync('jest --passWithNoTests --config src/jest.config.js',{stdio:'inherit',shell:true})}else{console.log('src/ missing — skipping core tests (dist is pre-built)')}"
scripts.lint: node -e "if(require('fs').existsSync('src')){require('child_process').execSync('eslint src --ext .ts --ignore-pattern \"src/dist\"',{stdio:'inherit',shell:true})}else{console.log('src/ missing — skipping core lint (dist is pre-built)')}"
scripts.typecheck: node -e "if(require('fs').existsSync('src/index.ts')){require('child_process').execSync('cd src && tsc --noEmit',{stdio:'inherit',shell:true})}else{console.log('src/ missing — skipping core typecheck (dist is pre-built)')}"
